cfb_fluview_away_market_elevated_on_benc.classification_evidence: Neither terminal ground is met. wrong_sign_resolved requires the WHOLE week-blocked interval on the wrong side of zero; this one is [-1.5529, +0.6943] and crosses it. positive_control_bound requires the instrument to have been PROVEN able to detect an effect of the size in question; the control here detected a +48.598 point leak (P+ 1.000), which proves the 36-column ridge fit is not blind but says nothing about detecting a sub-1-point effect, and the week-blocked CI spans 2.2 points, wider than the NFL reading being replicated. cfb_fluview_away_market_elevated_on_benc.description: CFB cross-league replication of NFL fluview_away_market_elevated_on_production. Away school home-state as-of CDC FluView ILI in that state top decile, added as exactly one column to the frozen XLG-03 CFB benchmark arm (market_residual, ridge alpha 10, min 500 training games, weekly walk-forward refits) and measured as the paired candidate-minus-baseline forced-pick accuracy delta, close-proxy median-book spread_line grade. Population: XLG-03 clean-core seasons with measured non-zero FluView coverage (2017-2019, 2021-2025), n=5671 scored games, 575 flagged elevated, 801 feature-missing. Baseline accuracy 51.402 pct, candidate 50.979 pct. State panel built from 42 states (19 fetched from Delphi this session, 23 reused from the frozen NFL snapshot); school to venue state joined on CFBD ESPN team_id from cfbfastR-data team_info, no name join, 0 unresolved rows.
cfb_fluview_away_market_elevated_on_benc.notes: PRIMARY cell, mirroring the NFL family own away-primary assignment (docs/fluview_on_production.md section 4). Season-blocked secondary: [-1.2751, +0.4566], P+ 0.173. Permutation null (200 within-week draws) mean +0.152 pts; observed sits at the 10.5th percentile of its own null. ERA MAGNITUDES, NOT AVERAGED: 2017-2019 delta +0.527 pts P+ 0.707 (n=2087, only 72 flagged); 2021-2025 delta -0.977 pts P+ 0.063 (n=3584, 503 flagged). These two eras carry OPPOSITE SIGNS, so the pooled figure above averages across a sign flip and must not be read as one era magnitude. The NFL on-production away cell was itself near a coin flip (0.000 pts, P+ 0.403), so this CFB read does not contradict a positive NFL finding for this cell. Secondary read on the full clean core including the zero-coverage 2012-2016 seasons is reported in docs/fluview_cfb_replication.md section 9. No NFL evaluation window and no rotation window spent. Interval contains zero, which is not grounds for rejection.
cfb_fluview_away_market_elevated_on_benc.plain_summary: Flu is running hot in the visiting school home state. On college football this did not help the model pick sides.

cfb_fluview_home_market_elevated_on_benc.description: CFB cross-league replication of NFL fluview_home_market_elevated_on_production (+0.969 accuracy points, P+ 0.792). Home school own-state as-of CDC FluView ILI in that state top decile, added as exactly one column to the frozen XLG-03 CFB benchmark arm (market_residual, ridge alpha 10, min 500 training games, weekly walk-forward refits) and measured as the paired candidate-minus-baseline forced-pick accuracy delta, close-proxy median-book spread_line grade. Population: XLG-03 clean-core seasons with measured non-zero FluView coverage (2017-2019, 2021-2025), n=5671 scored games, 579 flagged elevated, 796 feature-missing. Baseline accuracy 51.402 pct, candidate 51.014 pct. Underlying CFB state-week trait split-half reliability measured independently at Pearson r 0.9716, Spearman-Brown 0.9856 on 351 state-seasons, replicating the NFL trait 0.9814.
cfb_fluview_home_market_elevated_on_benc.notes: SECONDARY cell, mirroring the NFL family own home-secondary assignment (docs/fluview_on_production.md section 4); it is also the cell whose NFL on-production reading was the stronger of the two (+0.969 pts, P+ 0.792), so this is the direct replication test of that finding and it did NOT replicate in direction. Season-blocked secondary: [-1.1003, +0.2785], P+ 0.125. Permutation null (200 within-week draws) mean +0.116 pts; observed sits at the 10.5th percentile of its own null. ERA MAGNITUDES, NOT AVERAGED: 2017-2019 delta -0.767 pts P+ 0.205 (n=2087, 87 flagged); 2021-2025 delta -0.167 pts P+ 0.305 (n=3584, 492 flagged). Same sign in both eras, magnitude roughly 4.6x larger in the thinner earlier era. Secondary read on the full clean core including the zero-coverage 2012-2016 seasons: -0.246 pts, week 95 pct [-0.835, +0.340], P+ 0.195, n=8933. No NFL evaluation window and no rotation window spent; a CFB result never by itself changes an NFL card. Interval contains zero, which is not grounds for rejection.
